entities.summary: The Muhammadan Mosque is a historic mosque in Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia. It was constructed in 1843 and is associated with trade and traders from Gujarat, Mughal India. It is located on Batipuh Pasa Street in the South Padang District. Muhammadan Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1924. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
